pyramiding_rule: No scaling into positions until existing trades have moved at least +$6.00 in profit and stop-losses are locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR volatility buffer of at least 1.5x the current spread applied to all initial stop-loss placements to prevent noise-wick premature exits.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing locks when floating profit hits +$15.00 to ensure full capture of $15-$30+ asymmetric runs.
